sources.entry: CreatorSkills - Marketplace of 30+ downloadable AI skills for content creators covering YouTube scripting, sponsorship analysis, and audience growth. Works with Claude and ChatGPT. #paid

summary.name: Creator Skills
summary.one_liner: A marketplace of downloadable, multi-file AI workflow "skills" for content creators covering YouTube scripts, hooks, thumbnails, and repurposing.
use_cases: Generate scroll-stopping hooks for Shorts, Reels, and TikToks
Create thumbnail concepts and AI image prompts
Repurpose one video into threads, posts, and newsletters
Optimize YouTube titles, descriptions, and tags
summary.what_it_does: Creator Skills sells reusable workflow instructions, each built for one creator task such as scripting, thumbnails, hooks, or repurposing. A skill is delivered as a set of files (core instructions, templates, a README, and worked examples) and installed once into a supported AI tool. Skills export as SKILL.md for Claude and Claude Code, with the same text pasteable into Grok Bot, Muse, or OpenAI dots, and as .mdc for Cursor. The page lists 89+ skills in the catalog, priced at $7 each, with a bundle of five essential skills offered at $19 (listed at $35 value). Some free skills are available to try first.
notable: Skills are multi-file workflow packages (instructions, README, worked examples), not single prompts
Same skill files run across several AI tools and can be edited by the buyer
Ships a free tier: some skills are free, others $7 each or a $19 five-skill bundle
Time-saved estimates per skill (e.g. ~9.0h/mo for the long-form script system)
caveats: Paid skills cost $7 each; the five-skill starter bundle is $19
Requires your own account on a supported AI tool
Time-saved figures are estimates stated on the page, not verified results
Output still needs review for facts and voice before publishing
